title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: restart

thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters were excited by the return of the franchise and enjoyed the dark magical-girl premise.
The episode's many character introductions were viewed favorably, with some saying the pacing remained manageable despite the large cast.
Some commenters liked the action and found the character designs and cast setup promising.
The opening and ending music received enthusiastic reactions, including nostalgia for the performers.
Viewers differed on whether prior-season knowledge was necessary; some found the episode accessible while others felt its sequel connections reduced its standalone impact.
One commenter disliked the emphasis given to the apparent protagonist's romantic motivation and felt it omitted more meaningful characterization.
Another commenter was unconvinced by that protagonist and found a different character more interesting.

title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.

thread.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! • Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers found the premiere charming, cozy, funny, and more entertaining than expected.
The heroine was widely praised as adorable, expressive, and entertaining, especially her flustered romantic behavior.
Several commenters liked the show’s soft melancholy, romantic yearning, and contrast between serious and comedic moments.
The visual presentation, backgrounds, and overall animation were described as attractive and solid.
Some viewers enjoyed the opening and ending music for their soothing, wistful atmosphere.
A number of viewers were interested in continuing, but wanted to see whether the central romantic premise would remain engaging rather than become repetitive.
Some viewers disliked the ethical implications of love potions and dropped the series because of the premise.
A few commenters found the heroine’s prolonged pining uncomfortable or emotionally excessive.
